分发管线的构建脚：把审核通过的插件提交集合构建成 index.json 与逐文件: The build step of the distribution pipeline: turns reviewed plugin submissions into index.json and per-file artifacts (publishing and delisting are both expressed by rebuilding the index); validation shares its source with the repo CLI.
校验每份 manifest（分发门准入：版本必填合法、契约真能导出）并产出 in: Validates every manifest (distribution gate: version required and well-formed, contract must derive) and produces index.json plus per-file contents; if any entry fails the gate nothing is produced (problems are itemized). Optionally validates advisories.json (structure / refs must exist in the index / version expressions well-formed).
当前应上架的全部条目——发布=加进来重建，下架=去掉重建（消费端按 delist: All entries that should currently be listed — publishing adds one and rebuilds, delisting removes one and rebuilds (consumers treat vanished entries as delisted)
advisories.json 原文（可选）；校验结构、ref 引用与版本表达式: Raw advisories.json (optional); its structure, ref references and version expressions are validated — a broken file rejects the whole build
false = 有条目不过门，index 为空，看 problems: false = some entry failed the gate; index is empty, see problems
manifest / locales / README 逐文件铺开（相对 reg: manifest / locales / README laid out per file (relative to the registry root), uploaded to object storage together with the index
目录身份 <org>/<name> 的前半；须与 manifest 里的 plu: First half of the catalog identity <org>/<name>; must match plugin.org in the manifest
目录身份的后半；须与 manifest 里的 plugin.name 一致: Second half of the catalog identity; must match plugin.name in the manifest
